name: showStages
label: Show stages
description: Determines whether to show or hide the stage component.

name: playbookContextIdsInOrder
label: Playbook context IDs in order
description: An array of playbookContextIds. Determines the order of playbooks shown in the view.

name: playbooksByContextId
label: Playbooks by context ID
description: A map of playbooks using the context id of each playbook as the key.

name: playbookExperienceId
label: Playbook experience
description: The Playbook Experience that the playbook should use.

name: parentRecordUpdateTime
label: Parent record update time
description: A Unix timestamp of when the playbook's parent record has been updated.

name: optionalActivityTriggerContext
label: Optional activity trigger context
description: Contains info for adding optional activity triggers.

name: loadingActivities
label: Loading activities
description: A map of all loading activities.

name: daClientActionContract
label: DA client action contract
description: The contract that UI Builder uses to dynamically build the available declarative actions for event mapping.

name: compactMode
label: Compact Mode
description: Flag to determine whether to display in compact mode

name: usingMonolith
label: Using Monolith
description: Flag to determine if being used as part of now-playbook-experience-connected component.

name: loading
label: Loading
description: Flag to indicate the data broker is loading
